001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseOneTimeFactor;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
008
009public class SDShipsDestroyedFactor extends BaseOneTimeFactor {
010        
011
012        public static enum ShipsDestroyedType {
013                GENERAL,
014                REFORMER,
015                ABSOLUTIST,
016        }
017        
018        protected ShipsDestroyedType type;
019        public SDShipsDestroyedFactor(int points, ShipsDestroyedType type) {
020                super(points);
021                this.type = type;
022        }
023
024        @Override
025        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
026                if (type == ShipsDestroyedType.REFORMER) {
027                        return "Reformer fleet elements destroyed";
028                } else if (type == ShipsDestroyedType.ABSOLUTIST) {
029                        return "Absolutist fleet elements destroyed";
030                }
031                return "Sindrian Diktat fleet elements destroyed";
032        }
033
034        @Override
035        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(BaseEventIntel intel) {
036                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
037                        @Override
038                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
039                                if (type == ShipsDestroyedType.REFORMER) {
040                                        tooltip.addPara("Destroyed Sindrian Diktat fleet elements aligned with Achilles Andrada.", 0f);
041                                } else if (type == ShipsDestroyedType.ABSOLUTIST) {
042                                        tooltip.addPara("Destroyed Sindrian Diktat fleet elements aligned with Hector Andrada.", 0f);
043                                } else {
044                                        tooltip.addPara("Destroyed Sindrian Diktat fleet elements.", 0f);
045                                }
046                        }
047                        
048                };
049        }
050        
051}
